_schema_notes.coverage: Authoritative schema for all DID formats — DD Form 1664 (pre-2014) and free-text (post-2014 MIL-STD-963C)
_schema_notes.did_format: Set to 'dd_form_1664' or 'free_text'. Determines which fields are expected to be populated.
_schema_notes.963c_compliant: True if the DID was prepared under MIL-STD-963C (2014 or later). False for older DIDs.
_schema_notes.reserved_fields: Fields marked RESERVED are present in one format but not the other. Always include them — set to empty string or empty array when not applicable.
_schema_notes.preparation_instructions: Official MIL-STD-963C name for what was previously called 'requirements'. Contains the numbered sections of the DID. All section numbers are normalized to strictly numeric dot-notation (1, 1.1, 1.1.1). Letter-based source numbering (2.a, 3.1.b) is converted to numeric equivalents (2.1, 3.1.2).
_schema_notes.asterisk: True if the requirement number is followed by * in the source document (conditional requirement).

title: Estimated Weight and Balance Report - Mass Properties Data for Missiles
summary: Specifies format and content requirements for the Estimated Weight and Balance Report used to control and manage mass characteristics and minimize mass properties variations for missiles.
use_relationship:
Weight and Balance Reports are required to provide for control and management of mass characteristics and to ensure minimal mass properties variations.

This Data Item Description (DID) contains the format and content preparation instructions for the data product generated by the specific and discrete task requirement as delineated in the contract.

This DID supersedes DI-GDRQ-81234A.

Copies of S.A.W.E documents can be obtained from Society of Allied Weight Engineers, Inc., 375 Redondo Ave, Unit #624, Long Beach, CA, 90814.
distribution_statement: DISTRIBUTION STATEMENT A: Approved for public release; distribution is unlimited.

preparation_instructions.title: Reference Documents
preparation_instructions.content: The applicable issue of the documents cited herein, including their approval dates and dates of any applicable amendments, notices, and revisions, shall be as specified in the contract.

preparation_instructions.title: Format
preparation_instructions.content: The report shall be in contractor's format.

preparation_instructions.title: Content
preparation_instructions.content: The Estimated Weight and Balance Report shall be in accordance with the requirements of Society of Allied Weight Engineers (SAWE) Recommended Practice (R.P.) No.9. Copies of S.A.W.E documents can be obtained from Society of Allied Weight Engineers, Inc., 375 Redondo Ave, Unit #624, Long Beach, CA, 90814.

children.title: The weight statements in SAWE R.P.
children.content: The weight statements in SAWE R.P. No.10, Parts I and II, shall be used for the Estimated Report.

children.title: This report shall contain the maximum
children.content: This report shall contain the maximum and minimum weights and moments, with tolerances for each section, that must be held in order to achieve the desired weight and center of gravity of assembled missile.

children.title: The report shall also contain
children.content: The report shall also contain data to show the weight and balance impact of the complete missile installation on the specified launching aircraft. These data shall be in detail such that the Government can identify the individual electronic units.
